en: A black-and-white image depicting a large pile of boxed goods—possibly bales of fur or other merchandise—in front of a small wooden building. There are several men standing amidst the goods and near two rail cars. A distinctive flag, resembling the Hudson's Bay Company flag or English ensign, flies atop the building. The ground is muddy, and the setting appears frontier-like, probably in a cold or wet region.
